origin.name: Hungarian Neume Catalogue – Notation Signs in Medieval Hungary
origin.publisher: Institute of Musicology, Research Centre for the Humanities, Budapest
origin.note: The snippets are excerpts from manuscripts, whose copyright remains with their holders. They are used here with the agreement of the catalogue's editors: cite the catalogue (and the source of the snippet) when you use one.

columns.name: Punctum
columns.about: A single note. The catalogue does not say punctum from virga — a tall stroke is a virga (`*V`).

columns.name: Climacus
columns.about: A virga and falling notes: the number of notes decides the code.

columns.name: Cephalicus
columns.about: A clivis whose last note is liquescent.

columns.name: Strophicus
columns.about: Repeated notes on one pitch: two (bistropha), three (tristropha) or more.

columns.name: Pes subbipunctis
columns.about: A pes followed by two falling notes.

columns.name: Combinations
columns.about: Larger signs that mix several patterns. The catalogue gives no name: choose the code by the notes.
